title: CO mass balance equation
description: Essential: The student must derive the correct differential equation dC/dt + (u/W)C = M/(LWH) for the pollutant concentration.

title: CO concentration solution
description: Essential: The student must provide the correct solution C(t) = (M/(LHu))[1 - exp(-ut/W)].

title: Numerical CO concentration
description: Essential: The student must calculate the correct numerical value for C at 8:00 a.m. (approx. 2.3 mg/m³).

title: Parcel temperature derivation
description: Important: The student must correctly derive T_parcel(z) = T_parcel(0)[(T(0)-Λz)/T(0)]^(Γ/Λ) using adiabatic and hydrostatic principles.

title: Maximal altitude expression
description: Important: The student must derive the correct expression for the maximal altitude h in terms of Λ and Γ from the condition T_parcel(h)=T(h).

title: Lapse rate calculations
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the parcel temperatures at 96 m and 119 m using the given lapse rates and adiabatic expansion.

title: Mixing height determination
description: Important: The student must correctly determine the total maximal elevation H (mixing height) and the parcel temperature T_parcel(H).

title: Pressure profile derivation
description: Optional: The student should derive the correct pressure expressions p(z) for both uniform and linear temperature profiles.

title: Free convection condition
description: Optional: The student should identify the correct condition for free convection (Λ > μg/R).

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Deduct points for sign errors in differential equations, incorrect unit conversions, or misapplication of the adiabatic lapse rate.
